summary: All 15 are in their clubs' predicted XIs in the Premier League's MW11 line-ups; ESPN also predicts Gvardiol, Haaland and Gonzalo to start for City v Fulham, so those three are now start and the rest stay likely. Worries: Konsa (Saliba is ready to start), and Boscagli and Tavernier are one booking from a ban; Neto is predicted as Chelsea's striker with Joao Pedro out.
